newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, ASK S.AFRICA TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, ASK S.AFRICA TO BAT.

text.p: Stand-in Australian skipper Ian Healy won the toss and asked South Africa to bat in the third one day international between the sides at Cape Town on Wednesday. The series is level at 1-1.
South Africa - Herschelle Gibbs, Louis Koen, Jacques Kallis, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Derek Crookes, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Rudi Bryson, Allan Donald.
Australia - Michael Di Venuto, Mark Waugh, Stuart Law, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy (captain), Shane Warne, Paul Reiffel, Adam Dale, Jason Gillespie.
